note: Every quote below was located by byte offset in the staged bytes named in staged_path; the byte_offset field is the index of the FIRST occurrence and occurrences_in_staged_bytes is the count in that file. Quotes are verbatim substrings of the staged bytes (HTML markup included where the staged file is HTML).

quotes.quote: Returns a double representing the vertical scroll amount.
quotes.grounds: deltaY carries a double vertical scroll amount; the receipt may record e.deltaY as a measured scroll quantity rather than an inferred one.
quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground that deltaMode 0 means pixels (the constants are on the deltaMode sub-page), does NOT ground cross-build pixel identity, isTrusted, cancelable, or the 120px scroll arithmetic (this page contains zero occurrences of isTrusted and cancelable).

quotes.quote: Returns an unsigned long representing the unit of the delta* values' scroll amount.
quotes.grounds: deltaMode names the UNIT of the delta* values, so the receipt records the unit-bearing field instead of assuming a unit.
quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground the numeric value 0 = pixel; the MDN WheelEvent index page contains zero occurrences of DOM_DELTA_PIXEL / DOM_DELTA_LINE / DOM_DELTA_PAGE. Does NOT ground cross-build stability.

quotes.quote: The delta values are specified in pixels.
quotes.grounds: DOM_DELTA_PIXEL (0x00) is the pixel unit, so deltaMode 0 in the receipt is the pixel unit as documented, not an inference.
quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground that THIS Chromium build reports 0; the receipt still must measure deltaMode. Does NOT ground cross-build stability of the reported value.

quotes.anchor: §Permitted values table, note after the table
quotes.quote: Do not assume that those values are specified in pixels.
quotes.grounds: The documentation itself forbids assuming the pixel unit, which supports the receipt MEASURING deltaMode rather than assuming it.
quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground any Chromium behaviour; it is a caution to the reader, not a behaviour claim.

quotes.anchor: noscript static member index — Input.dispatchMouseEvent link
quotes.quote: Input.dispatchMouseEvent
quotes.grounds: The Input domain of the live protocol viewer exposes a dispatchMouseEvent command; this is the viewer-domain page the r64 claim names.
quotes.rejects: REJECTS as a semantic source: this served HTML is a 2349-byte JavaScript redirect stub whose only text is the redirect script plus the noscript member list. It contains ZERO occurrences of "Dispatches a mouse event" and ZERO of "deltaY". It grounds the command NAME, never the parameter semantics, never the delta unit, never any pixel identity.

quotes.anchor: noscript static member index — Page.captureScreenshot link
quotes.quote: Page.captureScreenshot
quotes.grounds: The Page domain of the live protocol viewer exposes a captureScreenshot command.
quotes.rejects: REJECTS as a semantic source: same redirect-stub shape (14155 B); ZERO occurrences of "Capture page screenshot". Grounds the command NAME only, not the png default, not the viewport bound, not any image determinism.

quotes.quote: attribute, on getting, must return the result of running these steps:
quotes.grounds: scrollTop is a spec-defined getter whose steps compute the element scroll position, so a scroll-position witness (window.scrollY on the document scrolling element) is an attribute-class witness.
quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground the exact accessor the page used, the scroll ARITHMETIC (how far one delta scrolls), smooth-vs-instant behaviour, cancelation, or event semantics. Also does NOT mention WheelEvent or deltaMode at all (zero occurrences of both) — CSSOM View cannot ground the wheel event record.

quotes.quote: gets scrolled (whether in response to user interaction or by an API), the user agent must run these steps:
quotes.grounds: A scroll queues a per-Document pending scroll event, so a receipt counting scroll events per leg reads a spec-defined event class.
quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground how many scroll events one wheel produces, nor that a swallowed (preventDefault-ed) wheel produces none; that is the measured pairing of the swallowed and released legs.

quotes.quote: pending scroll events
quotes.grounds: The scroll-event bookkeeping is a named spec list, so scrollEvents in the receipt names a spec-defined quantity.
quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground the count value 4, nor the coalescing semantics; MDN/CSSOM say nothing about wheel deltas here.

quotes.quote: must perform a coordinated viewport scroll by following these steps:
quotes.grounds: Viewport scrolling is a coordinated, defined operation, which is the spec class the r64 band-position witness measures.
quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground the 120px band geometry, the instant-vs-smooth choice the lane forces with --disable-smooth-scrolling, nor the settle loop; those are lane-implementation and measured facts.

quotes.quote: Y delta in CSS pixels for mouse wheel event (default: 0).
quotes.grounds: The CDP wheel delta is expressed in CSS pixels, so the fixture 120px bands and the dispatched deltaY share one unit.
quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground how far the page scrolls for that delta, nor that a listener may cancel it, nor that two captures are byte-identical. MASTER tip is a moving target: it was re-fetched twice this session and is byte-stable within the session (sha cb4b0a40…), but the row already held by S153 records a different digest (d6737c31…) for the same URL.

quotes.quote: Capture the screenshot beyond the viewport. Defaults to false.
quotes.grounds: The screenshot bound is a documented viewport-only default, so the receipt shot dimensions (1280x900) are the documented default surface.
quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground PNG byte determinism across runs, nor that band colours encode scroll position — those are the measured, live-verified facts of the r64 generation.

quotes.quote: Capture page screenshot.

quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground that the capture reflects THIS run — the r64 nonce-in-pixels binding is the lane’s own device, not the protocol’s.

quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground determinism. NOTE: the decoded bytes are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the already-held S105 (154.0.8037.97 Page.pdl, sha e944a3b1…) — a new row for this tag would be the same content under a new URL, i.e. a W04 same-content duplicate rather than a distinct source.

quotes.rejects: Same-byte note as Q17: identical content to S105 under a different tag URL.

quotes.anchor: §4 Extensions to the Window Interface — Window.scrollY attribute (id=dom-window-scrolly)
quotes.quote: attribute must return the y-coordinate,
quotes.grounds: Window.scrollY is itself a spec-defined attribute of the Window interface in the same draft, so the page reading window.scrollY is anchored by the SAME source that anchors Element.scrollTop — the r63 note said the spec anchored only the attribute class, not the exact accessor; this draft does define scrollY.
quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground the value 120/240, nor the arithmetic, nor that a wheel produced it. It is a definition, not a measurement.

quotes.quote: must perform a coordinated viewport scroll by following these steps:
quotes.grounds: Viewport scrolling is a coordinated operation, so the r64 band-position witness measures a spec-defined scroll outcome.
quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground the 120px band geometry, the instant-vs-smooth choice the lane forces with --disable-smooth-scrolling, nor the settle loop.

quotes.quote: in a user-agent-defined fashion over a user-agent-defined amount of time
quotes.grounds: A smooth scroll updates the scroll position over a user-agent-defined duration, which is exactly the variable the lane pins off with --disable-smooth-scrolling; the spec therefore names what that flag removes.
quotes.rejects: Does NOT ground the instant-scroll result the lane measures, nor how long any particular build takes. It states the variability the lane removes, not the value.
